authorizations_capture.purpose: A merchant can capture (settle) an authorized payment, either partially or in full, to complete a transaction and receive the funds.
examples: Capture the full $150.00 authorization from order #AUTH-12345 for customer jane@example.com.
Please settle the remaining $42.50 on authorization ID 8MT12345K1234567 — we're shipping the rest of the order today.
We only shipped part of the order, so capture just $89.99 from the $200 authorization on invoice INV-2024-09.
Did the $250 authorization from last Tuesday's order actually get captured yet, or is it still pending?
How much of the total authorized amount across all open orders this month has been captured versus still waiting?

authorizations_get.purpose: Shows details for a specific authorized payment, including its status, amount, and related transaction information.
examples: Show me the details for authorization ID AUTH-12345ABC67890DEF
What's the status of payment authorization 7GH89012IJ3456KLM?
Get the authorized amount and remaining balance for authorization 9MN01234OP5678QRS
Did the $249.99 authorization for customer jane.smith@example.com go through yesterday?
How much of the $1,500 authorization on order #ORD-98765 has been captured so far?

authorizations_reauthorize.purpose: A merchant can reauthorize an authorized PayPal payment to extend the hold on funds after the initial three-day honor period expires, ensuring the payment can still be captured within the 29-day authorization window.
examples: Can you reauthorize the payment for authorization ID 8AA12345KH678901L? The original hold expired and I still need to capture it.
Please extend the hold on the $150.00 payment from customer jane.smith@email.com — the authorization is about to expire.
Reauthorize the payment for order #ORD-7890, the authorization ID is 9BB67890PL123456M.
Did the reauthorization for authorization 7CC34567MN890123P go through successfully? I need to make sure the funds are still reserved.
How many times has authorization 5DD90123QR456789R been reauthorized? I want to check if we're near the limit.

authorizations_void.purpose: A merchant can cancel a previously authorized payment before it has been captured, releasing the hold on the buyer's funds.
examples: Cancel the authorization for order #AUTH12345 from yesterday.
Void the $150 hold on customer order 8XK12345AB6789.
Please release the pending authorization for transaction 7GH90123.
Did the $250 hold on invoice INV-2024-0422 get released yet?
How many authorized payments are still pending from last week that haven't been captured?

balances_get.purpose: A business user retrieves current or historical account balances across all currencies as of a specific date and time.
examples: Show me all our account balances as of March 15, 2024 at noon UTC.
What was the balance in our USD account on 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z?
Pull up the EUR balance snapshot for yesterday at 9 AM Eastern.
How much money did we have in total across all currencies at the end of last quarter?
Did our GBP balance change between December 1st and December 5th last year?

captures_get.purpose: Retrieves the complete details of a specific captured payment, including its status, amount, and transaction timestamps.
examples: Show me the details for capture 3C948598CS684452D
What was the status of the $149.99 payment capture from customer order #ORD-8823?
Get the payout info for capture ID 2JU268706B8122415
Did the payment for invoice INV-2024-05-177 go through successfully?
How much of the $500 authorization from customer sarah@acme.com was actually captured?

captures_refund.purpose: Allows a merchant to refund a captured payment, either fully or partially, by specifying the capture ID and optionally an amount, invoice ID, or note.
examples: Refund capture 2GG79123EB602430J in full, the customer cancelled their order.
Process a partial refund of $15.00 on capture 4KH98321FC712540K for the shipping delay.
Please refund $38.50 from capture 7RJ45678GB103970M and leave a note saying 'Damaged item—sorry for the trouble.'
Did we already refund capture 5LP67439DA825160N? I need to check if that payment reversal went through yet.
What's the total amount we've refunded on capture 9XT83456HB201480P so far? Is there any remaining balance we can still refund?

connections_get.purpose: Lists all accounting platform connections (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) that a merchant has set up for syncing invoice data.
examples: Show me which accounting platforms I'm connected to
What accounting integrations do I have active on my account?
List my connected accounting services
Do I have QuickBooks linked for invoice syncing?
How many accounting connections do I have set up right now?

customer_payment-tokens_get.purpose: Lists all stored payment tokens for a specific customer so you can view their saved payment methods.
examples: Show me all the saved payment methods for customer CUST_abc123.
What payment tokens are on file for customer ID 7a9b8c_d4e5?
List the payment methods stored for customer CUST_xyz789.
How many saved payment methods does customer CUST_abc123 have?
Does customer 7a9b8c_d4e5 have any stored payment tokens on their account?

disputes_accept-claim.purpose: Accepts liability for a dispute claim, automatically refunding the customer from the merchant's account and closing the dispute in the customer's favor.
examples: I need to accept the claim on dispute PP-D-29384 and refund the customer.
Go ahead and take the loss on dispute ID 7A3F2E — just accept the claim.
Can you accept liability for the chargeback on order #10492? The customer is right on this one.
What's the status of dispute PP-D-29384? Did we accept the claim or are we still fighting it?
How many disputes did we lose last month where we had to accept the claim and refund the customer?

disputes_accept-offer.purpose: A customer accepts a merchant's settlement offer on a dispute, which triggers an automatic refund of the proposed amount to the customer.
examples: Accept the $250 offer on dispute PP-123-456-789, please.
I'd like to agree to the merchant's proposal for case #DIS-2024-001.
Go ahead and accept the refund offer of $89.50 from Acme Corp for dispute DP-987654.
What's the status of the offer the merchant made on my chargeback for the laptop purchase? I want to accept it.
Did the $150 settlement offer on dispute PD-334455 get accepted yet? I told my customer to approve it yesterday.

disputes_acknowledge-return-item.purpose: A merchant submits proof that a customer returned a disputed item, moving the dispute toward resolution.
examples: I need to confirm that the customer sent back the item for dispute DS-7821.
Can you upload the signed return receipt for case #CASE-4392 to finalize the refund?
Please submit the tracking proof for the returned item in dispute 58a7b9c3.
Did we get confirmation that the item was returned for the chargeback on order #ORD-8821?
How many of the "not as described" disputes have been fully resolved after the customer sent the item back?

disputes_adjudicate.purpose: A merchant can settle a dispute in either their own favor or the customer's favor for sandbox testing purposes, simulating how PayPal normally resolves disputes.
examples: Settle dispute PP-001-234-567-890 in the buyer's favor.
Please close dispute 7HX12345KJ6789012 and rule it in my favor as the merchant.
I need to finalize dispute 5PP9876543 by awarding it to the customer.
How many disputes did I win vs lose last month?
What was the outcome of dispute PP-002-345-678-901 — did it get ruled for me or against me?

disputes_appeal.purpose: Appeal a dispute by submitting new evidence or notes to support your case.
examples: I need to appeal dispute DP-78342 with a signed delivery receipt — can you upload the PDF I just attached?
Please submit an appeal for dispute 9a2f1e8b with the customer's email confirmation as supporting evidence.
Appeal dispute ID 47b1-92e3 using the tracking proof document I'm attaching here.
Did we already appeal the chargeback for order #10492 from last week, or is it still waiting for evidence?
How many disputes are currently in the appeal stage, and which ones are past the 7-day deadline for submitting new evidence?

disputes_deny-offer.purpose: A business user rejects a settlement offer from the merchant for a specific dispute, optionally adding notes that only PayPal can see.
examples: Deny the settlement offer for dispute DISP-12345 because they only offered $50 but I'm owed $200.
Reject the merchant's offer on dispute #DISP-67890 and note that the item was never delivered.
I want to turn down the proposed resolution of $75 for dispute DISP-24680 since the product arrived damaged.
Did the merchant's offer on dispute DISP-13579 get formally denied yet or is it still pending?
How many offers have we rejected this month for chargebacks over $100?

disputes_escalate.purpose: Escalate a dispute to a formal PayPal claim when the dispute is still in the inquiry stage.
examples: Escalate dispute PP-D-12345 to a claim, the customer is not responding to my messages.
Please escalate my open inquiry with dispute ID PP-D-98765 to a PayPal claim.
I need to move dispute PP-D-45678 to a claim because the buyer filed a chargeback with their bank.
Can you check if dispute PP-D-33442 was escalated to a claim yet? I sent the escalation request yesterday.
How many of my open disputes in the inquiry stage have been escalated to claims this month?

disputes_get.purpose: A merchant retrieves the full details of a specific dispute, including its status, reason, and related transaction information, to review or respond to the case.
examples: Show me the details for dispute DIS-2024-03821.
What's the current status of dispute 7a9f3e2b-1c45?
Pull up the dispute with ID 48291 and tell me why it was filed.
How much money is at stake in dispute case-2024-112?
Did the customer win the dispute for transaction TXN-88473, and what was the reason given?

disputes_list.purpose: Lists disputes for a merchant with summary details like ID, reason, status, amount, and timestamps, with filtering by date range, transaction ID, state, and pagination.
examples: Show me all disputes from the last 30 days
List disputes for transaction TXN_9A2B3C4D
Get disputes in REVIEW state created since 2024-10-01
How many disputes did we have this month?
What's the status of dispute DPT-98765 and when was it last updated?

disputes_make-offer.purpose: A merchant sends a settlement offer to the other party in a dispute, specifying an amount and optional return shipping address, to try to resolve the case.
examples: Offer $150 to resolve dispute PP-D-28742 regarding the defective headphones.
Make a refund offer of 75 euros on dispute case DS-7T4G82 for the missing shipment.
Send an offer to the buyer in dispute 23A4B9C for the return of $200 with free shipping back.
What's the status of the offer I made on dispute PP-D-28742 yesterday? Did the buyer accept?
How many of my open disputes have received counteroffers versus pending my initial offer?

disputes_patch.purpose: Partially update a dispute's details, such as adding communication notes or partner action information, without replacing the entire dispute record.
examples: Update dispute DIS-12345 with the customer's latest email address support@acme.com.
Add a note to dispute 78901 saying the partner has initiated a chargeback reversal.
Change the communication detail on dispute 4455-AB to 'Refund issued on 2025-02-10 via original payment method'.
What's the current status of dispute 3321-XY — has the partner taken any action yet?
How many disputes from last month still have no partner action recorded?

disputes_provide-evidence.purpose: A merchant or customer can upload supporting evidence files for a specific dispute to help resolve it in their favor.
examples: Upload the proof of delivery PDF for dispute 8a3f-72b1.
I need to submit the refund receipt for order #1045 — the dispute ID is 9c2e-41d7.
Attach the tracking screenshot to dispute 5f1a-93c4, please.
Did the buyer ever upload their evidence for dispute 7b2d-18e6?
How many disputes are still waiting for my evidence so I can close them out?

disputes_provide-supporting-info.purpose: A merchant or buyer can upload evidence files to support their case in an active dispute.
examples: I need to upload the signed delivery receipt for dispute DP-2024-0381 to prove the item was delivered.
Can you submit the tracking confirmation PDF for chargeback 7a9f2c on my behalf?
Please attach the email thread with the customer showing they agreed to the refund terms for dispute DP-2024-112.
Did the buyer ever upload any supporting documents for dispute DP-2024-056?
How many disputes still need supporting evidence from us before the deadline next Friday?

disputes_require-evidence.purpose: Advances a dispute from under review to the evidence-collection phase, specifying whether the buyer or seller is now required to submit supporting documentation.
examples: Can you mark dispute DP-3842 as needing buyer response so we can gather their evidence?
Set dispute DP-2910 to waiting for seller evidence—we need the merchant to submit their proof of shipment.
Move dispute DP-4738 into the evidence collection phase for the seller side.
How many active disputes are currently awaiting buyer evidence submission?
What's the status of dispute DP-8312—has it moved to the evidence gathering stage yet?

disputes_send-message.purpose: A merchant or customer sends a message with optional supporting document to the other party in an active dispute that is still in the inquiry stage.
examples: Send a message to the customer about dispute DP-8842 explaining why the charge is valid.
Attach the signed delivery receipt to dispute 7A3F-2B1C and notify the buyer.
Reply to the merchant on dispute DP-9910 with the proof of return tracking number.
Did we send any follow-up messages to the cardholder for dispute DP-4521 after uploading the invoice?
How many disputes in inquiry stage still need a response from the other side?

event-types_list.purpose: Lists all event types a webhook is currently subscribed to, so you can verify or review which notifications the webhook will receive.
examples: What events is my webhook wh-abc123 currently subscribed to?
Show me the notification subscriptions for the webhook I set up for order updates.
List the event types registered on webhook wh-xyz789.
Is my inventory webhook still listening for product stock changes?
How many event subscriptions does webhook wh-def456 have, and which ones are active?

find_eligible_methods.purpose: A merchant can check which payment methods are available for a customer's purchase based on their location, currency, and other details.
examples: What payment options can I offer a customer in Germany buying €150 worth of goods?
Show me the eligible payment methods for order #ORD-78432 with a total of $230 USD.
Can a customer from Japan pay with PayPal for a ¥25,000 purchase through our mobile app?
Why didn't our UK customer see Klarna as an option for their £89.99 order?
List all available payment methods for a buyer in Australia using email customer@example.com on a desktop browser.

invoice_connection_details_get.purpose: Lists all accounting platform connections and their sync status for a specific invoice, helping merchants verify that their invoice data is reaching the right systems.
examples: Show me which accounting platforms my invoice INV-2024-001 is connected to
Check the connection status of invoice #3421 in QuickBooks and Xero
List all accounting sync connections for the invoice with ID 987654
Has invoice #5678 been synced successfully to our accounting system yet?
Are there any failed connections for invoice INV-2024-089 that need my attention?

invoices_cancel.purpose: A merchant cancels a sent invoice and optionally sends cancellation notifications to the payer, merchant, and additional CC recipients.
examples: Cancel invoice INV-2024-001 for the Smith project and send a cancellation notice to both myself and the client.
Please void invoice #1024 from last month and email a cancellation notification to support@vendor.com as a CC.
I need to cancel invoice INV-9876 that was sent to acme@company.com and notify the payer but not the merchant.
Did the invoice for the Johnson account (INV-334) get cancelled yet? I need to confirm it's been voided.
Show me all invoices that were cancelled last week—I want to see how many cancellations we processed between March 1 and March 7.

invoices_create.purpose: Creates a draft invoice with merchant and item details so it can later be sent to a buyer for payment.
examples: Create a draft invoice for $1,500 to Acme Corp for consulting services this month.
Draft a new invoice for project #2049 with 20 hours of design work at $85/hour.
Set up a draft invoice for Sarah from BlueLeaf Designs — include her email and due in 30 days.
How many draft invoices did I create last quarter that haven't been sent yet?
What's the total amount of unpaid draft invoices older than 60 days?

invoices_delete.purpose: A merchant removes a draft or scheduled invoice that hasn't been sent yet so it won't clutter their records or be processed accidentally.
examples: Get rid of invoice DRAFT-001 that I messed up.
Remove the scheduled invoice for $450 from last Tuesday — I need to redo it.
Delete the draft invoice for Acme Corp (ID: INV-2024-089).
How many draft invoices have we deleted this month?
Did that scheduled invoice for the Smith project get removed before it was sent?

invoices_generate-qr-code.purpose: Generates a QR code image for an invoice that customers can scan with their mobile devices to view or pay the invoice.
examples: Generate a QR code for invoice INV-2024-001 so I can add it to the PDF before mailing it to the customer.
Create a 300x300 pixel QR code for invoice INV-2024-042 with the pay action.
I need a QR code for invoice INV-2024-015 that shows the invoice details when scanned, not the payment page.
Can you make a QR code for invoice INV-2024-078 that's 400 pixels wide so it fits nicely on the printed statement?
What's the smallest QR code I can generate for invoice INV-2024-033 to put on the packing slip?

invoices_get.purpose: A merchant retrieves the full details of a specific invoice, including its status, line items, amounts, and customer information, using the invoice ID.
examples: Show me invoice INV-2024-8932
What's the status of invoice 4421 for the Johnson project?
Pull up the details for the March invoice from Acme Corp
How much was invoice INV-2024-7721 for, and has it been paid yet?
Can you re-send invoice #5583 to billing@example.com?

invoices_list.purpose: Lists invoices with optional filtering, pagination, and field selection so a merchant can view, search, or manage their invoice records.
examples: Show me my last 20 invoices.
List all unpaid invoices from March 2025.
I need to see invoices for customer jane@example.com.
How many invoices did I send last month?
Did invoice INV-2025-00423 get paid yet?

invoices_payments.purpose: Records a payment against a specific invoice so the system can update the invoice status to PAID or PARTIALLY PAID and track the outstanding balance.
examples: Can you record a payment of $250 for invoice INV-2024-089 via wire transfer? It came through yesterday.
Mark invoice #INV-2024-112 as paid — we received a check for $1,200 on March 15th.
Log an external cash payment of $85.50 for invoice INV-2024-054 and note it was paid at our retail counter.
What's the status of invoice INV-2024-077? Has any payment been applied to it yet?
How much is still outstanding on invoice INV-2024-033 after the partial payment we received last week?

invoices_payments-delete.purpose: Delete a recorded external payment from a draft invoice to correct a mistake or remove an incorrectly applied payment.
examples: Remove the $250 payment with transaction ID TXN-8842 from invoice INV-2024-039.
Delete the payment that was accidentally applied to draft invoice 8a3f7b from customer John.
Can you take off the Visa payment of $150.75 from invoice 4421? It was meant for a different order.
How many external payments are still attached to invoice INV-2024-039 after we removed the duplicate one?
Did the $300 refund transaction TXN-9912 get cleared from the draft invoice yet?

invoices_refunds.purpose: Records a refund against an invoice and updates the invoice status to REFUNDED or PARTIALLY_REFUNDED based on whether the full amount was returned.
examples: Refund invoice INV-2024-0891 for $150.00 via bank transfer.
Process a partial refund of $45.50 on invoice INV-2024-1023 using a credit card.
Record a cash refund for the full amount of invoice INV-2024-0772 from last week.
Did invoice INV-2024-0915 get fully refunded or is it still partially paid?
What's the total amount refunded on invoice INV-2024-0653 so far?

invoices_refunds-delete.purpose: Allows a business user to delete a previously recorded external refund from a draft invoice, removing that refund entry from the invoice record.
examples: Can you delete the refund transaction TXN-8842 from invoice INV-2024-3891?
Please remove the $250 refund I recorded on invoice #10293 by mistake.
I need to delete that refund entry tied to transaction 7A9F2C from the November invoice for Acme Corp.
Why does invoice INV-3342 still show a refund of $150 when I voided that payment last week?
How many refund adjustments have been removed from our invoices this quarter?

invoices_remind.purpose: Send a reminder notification to the payer for a specific invoice, optionally including a subject line, a note, and CC recipients.
examples: Send a reminder to john@example.com about invoice INV-2024-001 that's still unpaid.
Can you ping the client about invoice INV-2024-045? It's 14 days overdue.
Remind the buyer about invoice 8BX12345YX678901M and note that the due date was last Friday.
How many reminders have we already sent today for invoice INV-2024-032? I don't want to exceed the limit.
Did we send the reminder for the $2,450.00 invoice to jane.smith@vendor.com yet this morning?

invoices_search-invoices.purpose: Search for and filter invoices based on various criteria like recipient details, invoice number, status, amount range, currency, and other fields.
examples: Find all invoices sent to john@example.com that are still in "DRAFT" status.
Show me invoices from last month with a total amount between $500 and $2,000.
Search for invoice number INV-2024-0892 and tell me its current status.
How many unpaid invoices do we have for Acme Corp with a total over $10,000?
Did Sarah Johnson ever receive invoice #1045, and has it been paid yet?

invoices_send.purpose: Send or schedule an invoice to be delivered to a customer, either immediately or on a future date.
examples: Send invoice INV-2024-0892 to the customer right now.
Schedule invoice #8432 to go out on next Monday, December 18th.
Please resend the invoice for order 5503 to john@example.com and also cc my accountant.
Did invoice INV-2024-0892 get sent yet?
How many invoices are currently scheduled to go out this week?

invoices_update.purpose: A merchant fully replaces all details of an existing invoice, such as its status, recipient, dates, line items, or payment terms, by providing a complete updated invoice object.
examples: Update invoice INV-2024-089 to show it's been paid in full as of today.
Change the due date on invoice INV-089 to May 15, 2025, and set the status back to draft.
Fully replace the customer details on invoice INV-2024-089 with Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@example.com) as the new recipient.
Has invoice INV-2024-089 been paid or is it still outstanding?
How many times has the recipient been changed on invoice INV-089 in the last 3 days?

invoicing_generate-next-invoice-number.purpose: Merchants generate the next sequential invoice number so they can assign a unique, properly formatted identifier to their next customer invoice.
examples: What's the next invoice number I should use for my new order?
Get me a fresh invoice number to bill Acme Corp for $2,450.
I need to generate the next available invoice number for receipt #2024-891.
Did we already use INV-5678 or is that still available for the upcoming billing cycle?
How many invoices have we issued so far this month—and what number should I start with for the next one?

orders_authorize.purpose: A merchant authorizes payment for an approved order to capture the funds and complete the transaction.
examples: Authorize payment for order 8GH12345JKL that the customer just approved.
Please capture the funds for order 9AB67890XYZ — the buyer has already given the go-ahead.
I need to finalize payment on order 4CD11223WER using the saved card on file.
Did the payment for order 2EF33445QAZ go through after the customer approved it?
What's the total amount authorized on order 7HI55667UJM so far?

orders_capture.purpose: Captures payment for an approved order so the merchant can complete the transaction and receive funds.
examples: Capture the payment for order 8FJ48203KH901234L.
Please finalize payment on order 7XK92045RT672890P — the buyer already approved it.
I need to settle order 3MN56178AB234567Q now that the customer has confirmed.
Did the payment for order 2BC34901XY890123R go through successfully yesterday?
How much total revenue did we capture from orders approved last week?

orders_confirm.purpose: A merchant or payer confirms their intent to pay for an order using a specific payment source like a card, PayPal, or a saved token.
examples: Confirm my payment with card ending 4321 for order ORD-5A8B2C
I'd like to finalize my PayPal payment for order 7X9K1M
Please complete the purchase for order A1B2C3 using my saved billing agreement
Did order 9Z8Y7W get paid successfully after I submitted my card details?
What's the status of my order 3X4Y5Z — has my payment been confirmed yet?

orders_create.purpose: Creates a new order for a customer, specifying payment intent, payer details, and purchase items.
examples: Create an order for $49.99 from customer jane@example.com with intent to capture payment immediately.
Set up an authorization order for $120.00 from buyer John Smith, including his tax ID BR_CNPJ 12.345.678/0001-90.
Place a new order for 3 units of item SKU-1001 at $15 each, billing to the customer's address in country code US.
Did the order from maria@shop.com for $89.50 go through successfully or is it still pending?
How many orders were created yesterday with a CAPTURE intent, and what's the total dollar amount?

orders_get.purpose: Allows a business user to retrieve the full details of a specific order by its ID, including payment source, amounts, and line items.
examples: Show me the details for order 8WH12345KU
What was the payment method used on order 4TH78901AB?
Pull up the shipping address and total for order 2MN34567CD
Was order 9XY67890EF paid with PayPal or a card?
How many items were in my last big order from last Tuesday?

orders_patch.purpose: Update the details of an existing order that hasn't been completed yet, such as changing the shipping address, items, or amounts.
examples: Can you update order #5A3B2C1 to change the shipping address to 123 Oak Street, Austin, TX 78701?
I need to replace the item in order #8F7E6D0 from a small blue t-shirt to a medium red one.
Please add a 10% discount to order #2G4H6J8 before we finalize it.
Did order #9K1L3M5 get updated with the new shipping method I requested earlier today?
What's the current total on order #4P7Q2R9 after the price adjustment we discussed?

orders_track_create.purpose: Add shipment tracking information (carrier and tracking number) to an existing order so the merchant and buyer can monitor delivery progress.
examples: Add tracking number DHL9832 to order 45GH7 using DHL carrier.
Can you attach tracking info TRACK123 from USPS to my order 89KL2?
Set the tracking for order 23AB1 to FedEx with number FX-90210 and notify the customer.
Was order 67MN8 shipped yet? I need to know if tracking was added.
How many of my orders from last week have tracking numbers attached to them?

orders_trackers_patch.purpose: A merchant can update or cancel tracking information for a customer's order, such as changing the tracking number, carrier, or shipment status.
examples: Update the tracking number for order 8WH12345ABC to 1Z999AA10123456784 with UPS.
Cancel the tracking for order 3RJ78901XYZ, tracker TRK001, because the shipment was returned.
Change the carrier from USPS to FedEx for order 5PL45678DEF, tracker TRK002.
Did the tracking info for order 2AB34567GHI get updated to the new FedEx number yet?
How many items in order 9XY90123JKL were actually delivered according to the latest tracker update?

partner-referrals_create.purpose: A business user creates a partner referral to onboard a new seller by sharing their personal, business, and financial details with PayPal.
examples: I need to submit a referral for a new seller, Jane Smith, with her business email jane@smithco.com and a tracking ID of REF-2024-001.
Please create a partner referral for a merchant in India with a purpose code of 'P0102' and an annual sales volume between $50,000 and $100,000.
Set up a new seller referral for ABC Corp, including their beneficial owner details and a return URL of https://mypartner.com/return for the onboarding flow.
Did the referral for the seller with tracking ID TRK-8823 get submitted successfully, or is it still pending?
How many new seller referrals have we created this month, and what's the average monthly volume range for those merchants?

partner-referrals_read.purpose: Shows the full details of a specific partner referral record by its ID, so the merchant can review the referral's status, shared data, and history.
examples: Show me the details for partner referral ID pref_9a8b7c6d5e.
What's the current status of referral pref_3f2e1d0c9b?
Pull up the referral record with ID pref_7a6b5c4d3e so I can see what data was shared.
Did the referral from partner ABC Corp on March 12 go through? The ID is pref_2b1c0d9e8f.
How many times has referral pref_4e5f6a7b8c been updated and what's the latest status?

payment-tokens_create.purpose: Allows a merchant to store a customer's payment source (e.g., credit or debit card) in the PayPal Vault for future use in repeat transactions.
examples: Save my customer's Visa card ending in 1234 to their vault so I don't have to ask for it again.
Add this new MasterCard 5555-xxxx-xxxx-8888 to customer vault for Jane Smith (customer ID CUST-98765).
Store the Amex card with expiration 2027-03 for recurring billing on my customer's profile.
Did customer ID ABC-12345 successfully have their payment method vaulted last week?
How many cards do we currently have stored in our customers' vaults across all accounts?

payment-tokens_delete.purpose: Deletes a specific saved payment token so the merchant can remove outdated, expired, or unwanted payment methods from a customer's vault.
examples: Delete payment token tok_7H9kL2mN4pQ for customer order #4821.
Remove the saved Visa ending in 1234 from my wallet.
Clear out the expired payment method associated with token ABC-xyz_9876.
How many payment tokens are currently stored for recurring billing profiles?
Did the token for the Amex card I added last week get deleted after the failed renewal attempt?

payment-tokens_get.purpose: A business user can look up the full details of a vaulted payment source — such as card type, last four digits, expiration date, or PayPal account email — using the token ID stored for that customer.
examples: Show me the vaulted payment source for token ID abc123_def456
What payment method is stored under vault token xyz789_abc321?
Pull up the details for payment token tok_5f8a2b1c3d4e5

webhooks_delete.purpose: Deletes a webhook notification subscription so the merchant stops receiving automated updates at that endpoint.
examples: Please remove the webhook that sends order updates to https://myapp.com/hooks/orders.
Cancel the notification endpoint that was set up for refund alerts on March 12.
I need to delete the webhook with ID wh_8f3a2b1c that's pushing inventory changes to our warehouse system.
Why am I still getting payment failure alerts at https://example.com/notify? I thought we turned that off last week.
How many active webhooks do I have right now? I want to clean up the ones I don't use anymore.

webhooks_get.purpose: Shows the configuration and subscription details for a specific webhook, identified by its ID.
examples: Show me the details for webhook wh_abc123
What subscriptions are set up on webhook wh_xyz789?
Pull up the configuration for my order-notification webhook (ID wh_456def)
Did the webhook I created last week (wh_789ghi) get set up with the right endpoint?
What's the current status of webhook wh_321jkl — is it active or paused?

webhooks_list.purpose: Lists all webhook subscriptions configured for an app, allowing a user to review or manage which events trigger notifications.
examples: Show me all the webhooks I've set up for my store.
What notifications are currently being sent to my order processing system?
List the webhook endpoints configured for my application.
How many active webhook subscriptions do I have right now?
Did I already set up a webhook for new customer sign-ups?

webhooks_post.purpose: Creates a webhook subscription so that a specified URL receives real-time notifications when selected events occur.
examples: Set up a webhook at https://my-shop.example.com/listener to get notified whenever an order is placed or a refund is issued.
Please subscribe my endpoint https://webhooks.mycompany.io/events to all store events, including any new event types added in the future.
I need to receive push notifications at https://api.myshop.com/hooks whenever a customer creates an account or updates their profile.
Did any webhook notifications get sent to my server last night for failed payment events?
How many active webhook subscriptions do I currently have, and which event types are each one listening for?

webhooks_update.purpose: A business user can update an existing webhook's URL or the list of events it listens for without deleting and recreating the webhook.
examples: Change the callback URL for webhook wh_abc123 to https://myapp.com/notifications/v2.
Update my order confirmation webhook so it also fires on refund events, not just completed payments.
Switch the endpoint URL for webhook wh_xyz789 from the staging server to the production server.
Did my webhook for abandoned carts get updated to include the new checkout events yesterday?
How many webhooks are currently set to listen for inventory changes instead of payment events?
